subject: Phase 100378: Full CLI Configuration, Ranking, and Sync Surface
verdict_justification: Phase 100378 cleanly implements the full CLI configuration, ranking, and sync surface (clio config get/set/profiles/use, clio ranking get/set, and clio sync status/push/pull/serve) through existing shared runtime and MCP dispatchers, preserving exact tool semantics and fail-closed security guarantees. Masking is verified across all config views, weight normalization and dry-run work as specified, single-host sync correctly explains the FR-31 omission, all files strictly adhere to <=450 lines and AGENTS.md headers, and all 311 reported files satisfy >=90% line and function coverage floors. Three minor findings were identified regarding single-host sync argument validation, patch-file error messaging, and an unnecessary 1-second sleep in unit tests.

findings.title: `sync status` skips positional and flag validation on single-host deployments
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs:108-114 (`if sub == "status" && single_host { return emit_single_host(io, mode); }`). Live verification: `./target/debug/clio sync status unexpected_arg` exits 0 on single-host, but exits 2 with `unexpected extra argument` on multi-host (`sync.omit=false`). Likewise, `./target/debug/clio sync status --banks ""` exits 0 on single-host but exits 2 on multi-host.
findings.recommendation: In `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs`, run `crate::runtime_cli::no_positionals(&parsed)?` and validate argument flags prior to short-circuiting for `single_host`, ensuring consistent exit-code 2 usage errors across deployment modes.

findings.title: `ranking set` error message references `--patch` when `--patch-file` contains invalid JSON
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs:103-105 (`serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|error| CliError::usage(format!("--patch must be a JSON object: {error}")))?; if !patch.is_object() { return Err(CliError::usage("--patch must be a JSON object")); }`). Live verification: `./target/debug/clio ranking set --patch-file=/tmp/invalid.json` outputs `error: --patch must be a JSON object`.
findings.recommendation: In `crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs`, dynamically mention `--patch-file` or use `"--patch or --patch-file must provide a JSON object"` in the error messages.

findings.title: Unit test `render_dispatches_and_covers_transfer_and_serve_banks` incurs an unconditional 1-second sleep
findings.recommendation: Avoid real 1-second sleeps in unit test suites. Parameterize `wait_for_ttl` or test sleep duration with millisecond resolution / injectable sleep mock so unit test suites remain fast.

plan_1hr: In `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs`, validate `no_positionals(&parsed)` and `--banks` before returning the single-host omission explanation in `sync status`.
In `crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs`, update the JSON parse and object check error messages to reference `--patch / --patch-file` appropriately.
In `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli_tests.rs`, remove the 1-second `wait_for_ttl(1)` call or mock sleep to avoid slowing down unit test runs.
plan_unlimited: Consider adding a persistent scope or file-target mechanism for ranking environments if offline tuning without an active session is desired in future phases.
Consider adding a `--timeout` flag or daemonization mode for `sync serve` to support background supervisor workflows beyond foreground TTL waits.
